First, "The flow is armed, so the check also stamps the plan" is the only place After hints at a write; a careful reader could wonder whether a stamp is a file edit, so say explicitly that the stamp is tracker/check state recorded by the tool, not an edit to the plan file (or drop the sentence, since this case is not a loop/armed scenario). Ending at the printed closing line, as Before does, keeps the narration within scope while the Change's loop-engine wording (ledger skip reason, armed flow, check 6) stays confined to the branches where a ledger or Engine loop actually exists.
